article.headline: Estevez scores 25, Wagner downs Bryant & Stratton-Albany 117-51
article.description: — Cam Estevez scored 25 points as Wagner beat Bryant & Stratton-Albany 117-51 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Estevez scores 25, Wagner downs Bryant & Stratton-Albany 117-51
article.story: STATEN ISLAND, N.Y. -- — Cam Estevez scored 25 points as Wagner beat Bryant & Stratton-Albany 117-51 on Wednesday. Estevez went 9 of 17 from the field (5 for 11 from 3-point range) for the Seahawks (1-3). Tajae Jones and Kareem Watson added 16 points each, while Jones had 10 rebounds. Bryce Simmons led the Bobcats in scoring, finishing with 22 points and four steals. Zay Little added 18 points for Bryant & Stratton-Albany. Up next Wagner’s next game is Tuesday against Saint Joseph’s (PA) on the road. Bryant & Stratton-Albany visits Princeton on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
